name: XPRS 1.12.0-beta.1
body:
Beta: test it before 1.12.0 goes to the stable channel and F-Droid.

## Chat and posts
- Links in chat messages and forum posts are tappable and open in your browser.
- Messages and posts show formatting: **bold**, *italic*, ~~struck~~, `code`, headings, lists and quotes, read the same way as in the web chat.
- A bare link stops before trailing punctuation or emphasis marks, so `**https://example.org**` is a bold link (the web chat reads it the same way).

## Fixes
- A long status was shown up to three times on its author's phone, with words glued together ("seethe"). It now shows once, its parts joined correctly (Status wapp 0.5.7).
- Parts of a long status heard live are no longer shown as separate posts.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xprs-dev/app/compare/v1.11.0...v1.12.0-beta.1
